title: 2D Convolution
hint: Extract patches using unfold or nested loops. For each output position, sum(patch * kernel). Support stride and padding (zero-pad with F.pad).

description.text: Implement 2D convolution: x (B, C_in, H, W), weight (C_out, C_in, kH, kW), optional bias (C_out,). Support stride and zero-padding. Do not call F.conv2d or nn.Conv2d; F.pad for padding is allowed.

examples.output: y (1, 16, 32, 32) when padding preserves spatial size.
examples.explanation: Each output channel is a sum over input channels of slid kernels.

constraints: Do not use F.conv2d or nn.Conv2d.
bias optional; if present, add per output channel.
